source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polygenic inheritance (PDF 96-98).

blocks.text: Polygenic khasiyatein aik nahi balke bohat se gene jore qaboo karte hain. In genes ke sab alleles aik hi khasiyat mein jama (additive) tareeqe se hissa daalte hain, kuch asar barhate aur kuch ghatate hain, aur un ka majmooi asar aik khasiyat banata hai. Is liye polygenic khasiyatein aabadi mein farq ka silsila, yaani musalsal variation, dikhati hain.
Polygenic khasiyaton ki misalein insanon mein qad, jild ka rang, wazan aur zehanat, aur paudon mein daane ka rang hain.
Insani jild ke rang ki virasat

Jild ka rang melanin pigment ki miqdar par hai: zyada melanin se gehri jild. Taqreeban 60 genes shamil hain, lekin samajhne ke liye teen genes, A, B aur C, liye jate hain; alleles A, B aur C zyada melanin aur a, b aur c kam banate hain.

items: AABBCC (bohat gehra) x aabbcc (bohat halka) se sab bachche AaBbCc, darmiyane rang ke.
Do triple heterozygotes (AaBbCc x AaBbCc) se bachche bohat gehre se bohat halke tak 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1 nisbat mein.
AABBCC sab se gehra (zyada se zyada melanin) aur aabbcc sab se halka (kam se kam melanin).

blocks.text: Gandum ke daane ka rang safaid se gehre surkh tak musalsal badalta hai aur teen polygenes, A, B aur C, qaboo karte hain. Har dominant allele surkh rang banata aur har recessive allele nahi, is liye AABBCC daane gehre surkh aur aabbcc safaid. Gehra surkh AABBCC x safaid aabbcc se darmiyana surkh AaBbCc F1 milta hai. F2 mein rangon ka wasee silsila aata hai: 64 mein se aik paude ke daane sab se gehre surkh (AABBCC), aik ke safaid, aur 62 surkh ke darmiyane se bohat halke rangon tak.

blocks.alt: AaBbCc x AaBbCc gandum ke F2 ka bar chart. Saat bars, baen taraf 6 dominant alleles se daen taraf 0 tak, unchaai 1, 6, 15, 20, 15, 6 aur 1, rang sab se gehre surkh se safaid tak, har bar ke neeche usi rang ka dana. Note: 64 mein se 1 sab se gehra surkh (AABBCC), 62 darmiyani rangon ke aur 1 safaid (aabbcc).
blocks.caption: AaBbCc x AaBbCc gandum ke F2 mein daane ka rang (Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gandum ke daane ka rang teen genes, A, B aur C, qaboo karte hain; har dominant allele surkh rang (pigment) barhata aur har recessive allele kuch nahi, is liye rang is par hai ke daane mein kitne dominant alleles hain. Gehra surkh AABBCC x safaid aabbcc se darmiyana AaBbCc F1 milta hai. Do F1 paude milane se 64 milap bante hain jo dominant alleles ki ginti, chhe se sifar tak, ke hisaab se 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1 hain. Sab se gehre surkh aur safaid ke darmiyan bohat se chhote qadam variation ko musalsal (continuous) banate hain.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Mahol ke awamil (factors) jaise roshni, paani aur ghizai ajza bhi daane ke rang par asar dalte hain.

blocks.prompt: AaBbCc x AaBbCc se 64 milap kyun bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Har walid 2 x 2 x 2 = 8 qisam ke gametes banata hai, aur fertilization par 8 x 8 = 64 milap mumkin hain.

items: Polygenic: bohat se genes, jama asar, musalsal variation.
Misalein: qad, jild ka rang, wazan, zehanat, daane ka rang.
